answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared lagoon of collateral before it can trade: the stake is slashed if peers attest misbehavior, so one operator running a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand separate stakes. Reputation then accrues per stake, not per account, and a periodic summit of high-reputation agents audits new entrants, raising the cost of flooding the island of honest participants beyond any profit the fakes could extract.
